about: Held-out fictional transcripts written after the on-phone extractor was tuned on corpus.json. Not used for tuning. Same label format.

cases.transcript:
Rosa: Okay so plants. If a customer buys a tree, offer the free planting guide.
Me: Where are those?
Rosa: Under the register. And when the hose cart is empty, refill it from the back tap.
Rosa: Watering happens at 7 and at 3, every day.
Rosa: We might do a pumpkin thing in October.

Eli: At the ticket stand, check the age on R-rated tickets.
Eli: Spilled popcorn gets swept before the next show starts.
Eli: When the fire alarm goes, open all exit doors and walk people out, no running.
Eli: I think the manager prefers we upsell the large combo, but don't push it.

Dev: Before a car goes in, fold the mirrors in.
Dev: Never take a car with a roof rack, send it to hand wash.
Me: What if they argue?
Dev: Then get me.
Dev: Tips go in the jar by the vacuum.

Ines: Tours start every hour on the hour.
Ines: If a kid touches an exhibit, gently remind the parent about the no-touch rule.
Ines: Lost items go to the coat check with a note of where you found them.
Ines: Honestly the audio guides break a lot, maybe check them before opening.

Marco: Cash goes in the lockbox, never in your pocket, not even for a second.
Marco: When we run out of an item, flip its card on the menu board.
Marco: Make sure the generator is off before you refuel it.
Marco: Sunday hours are probably changing.

Ms. Park: For late arrivals, the student signs the late book and gets a pink slip.
Ms. Park: If a parent calls to say a child is sick, write it in the absence log with the time of the call.
Ms. Park: Visitors wear a sticker badge the whole time they are in the building.
Ms. Park: The copier code is on the wall.

Tom: Skate rentals need a shoe left as a deposit.
Tom: When the ice gets choppy, tell the Zamboni driver on the radio.
Tom: Anyone without a helmet under 12 can't go on the ice.
Tom: Kind of a slow day today, enjoy it.

June: Drop-off laundry gets a numbered ticket, one half on the bag, one half to the customer.
June: If a machine eats coins, refund from the coin drawer and put an out-of-order sign on it.
June: Close up at 10 sharp.
Me: Okay. Anything else?
June: Nope, that's it.

Abby: Eggs stay in the cooler, not on the table.
Abby: When someone pays by card, use the little reader and give them the paper receipt.
Abby: If it rains, pull the berries under the tent.
Abby: My dad usually comes by around noon to restock, I think.

Liz: Did you see the game last night?
Me: No, I missed it. Who won?
Liz: We did, barely. You should come watch with us next time.
Me: Sure, maybe.
